summary.text: Dave Zimmerman is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House District 99, in Berks and Lancaster counties, since December 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He serves on the Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Environmental and Natural Resource Protection, and Health and Insurance committees.

paragraphs.text: David H. Zimmerman worked in agri-business before entering office, serving as a sales manager for Lancaster County, then for all of Pennsylvania, and ultimately for seven eastern states at an international company of 1,100 employees, according to his official biography.
He served on the Lancaster County Agricultural Preservation Board, the Lancaster County Transportation Committee and the Lancaster County Planning Commission.
In 2005 his colleagues chose him as chairman of the East Earl Township Board of Supervisors, and in 2006 he became the township's roadmaster.
Zimmerman was elected to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives in 2014.
His official biography describes him as a fiscal conservative and says he represents municipalities in Berks and Lancaster counties.
He is a lifelong Lancaster County resident who lives in East Earl Township with his wife, Ruth Ann; they have three children and nine grandchildren.
